unitTests.scope: Existing regressions through the compiled backend use the original independent interpreter behavior, not native-engine certification.

referenceProvenance.captureMethod: Unmodified official Linux executable; shared QA Common.Lua capture and AssertInput driver

interactions.scope: Identical authored neutral setup and AssertInput CNS recipes; primary state/motion/contact fields only. Native common-state implementation is not loaded. Palette pixels, full helper/projectile field traces, and full native resource identity are not compared. Differences remain explicit; no certification is claimed.

referenceProvenance.captureMethod: Unmodified official Linux executable; shared QA Common.Lua capture and AssertInput driver

movesets.scope: Identical authored neutral setup and AssertInput CNS recipes; primary state/motion/contact fields only. Native common-state implementation is not loaded. Palette pixels, full helper/projectile field traces, and full native resource identity are not compared. Differences remain explicit; no certification is claimed.

benchmark.scope: Host numeric expression microbenchmark, not phone FPS or complete engine parity.

movesetImprovement.scope: Root combat trace fields across the same 147 captured scenarios in their original order; not a frame-rate benchmark or full compatibility claim.

baseline.expressionBackend: Independent JS interpreter, identical for baseline and optimized runs
baseline.scope: Headless fixed-tick CPU simulation of authored synthetic loads, including CNS, contact scanning and cleanup. No graphics, archive loading or audio; no browser or phone FPS claim.

optimized.expressionBackend: Independent JS interpreter, identical for baseline and optimized runs
optimized.scope: Headless fixed-tick CPU simulation of authored synthetic loads, including CNS, contact scanning and cleanup. No graphics, archive loading or audio; no browser or phone FPS claim.

combatBenchmark.scope: Sequential host samples with identical checksums. Shared independent JS interpreter. No browser or phone FPS or full-native-engine speed comparison.

reference.method: Unmodified official Linux executable with authored CNS VarSet probes; fractional inside/outside positions, both facings, Width edge changes, 320/1280 coordinates. Samples are CNS reads before movement/clamping.

edgeTriggerProbes.scope: 480 exact CNS trigger reads from 120 observations: both facings, fractional inside/outside positions, standing/airborne, Width changes, localcoord widths 320 and 1280, fixed camera at zoom 1.

reference.method: Unmodified official Linux executable, original KFM data and authored QA AssertInput recipe for kfm-100-0-1-near. Authored -3 controllers sample velocity, threshold and state time before the common state runs. The second run injects x velocity 10 at idle time 1. No native implementation source was read.

idleStopProbes.scope: Default standing idle with no direction held, ground friction .85 and threshold 2, localcoord 320. Does not establish other common-state or physics profiles.

baseline.scope: Authored headless animation trigger reads through the shared independent JS interpreter. Includes finite loop offsets and changing queried elements. Excludes match simulation, rendering, audio and loading; not browser or phone FPS.

optimized.scope: Authored headless animation trigger reads through the shared independent JS interpreter. Includes finite loop offsets and changing queried elements. Excludes match simulation, rendering, audio and loading; not browser or phone FPS.

animationBenchmark.scope: Sequential host samples with identical checksums. Shared independent JS interpreter. No browser or phone FPS or full-native-engine speed comparison.

reference.method: Unmodified official Linux executable with original KFM data, authored QA AssertInput, and independently authored ignorehitpause VarSet/ChangeAnim probes. Selected samples compare CNS reads with post-tick externally observable animation clocks.

animationPauseProbes.scope: Standing KFM attacks at localcoord 320; ordinary pause, same-action reset, different-action reset, repeated resets, loop boundaries and reset-to-first-element. External clocks, CNS reads and sprite dimensions/axis offsets are separate observations. No claim for every pause/controller combination.

reference.method: Unmodified official Linux executable; original KFM data with independently authored standing/air/lying state 0 position sweeps. Victim primary and state files both select its own authored states. Width overrides and an authored wide hurt box distinguish reciprocal push checks from mere rounding of axes. The first cycle is excluded to remove neutral-setup effects.

bodyPushProbes.scope: Float32 reciprocal body push in a fixed 320-wide viewport, facing 1, ground front/back 16/15, air front/back 12/12, standing player and standing/air/lying victim. Original KFM hurt boxes unless explicitly replaced by [-40,-90,40,0]. Does not establish all multi-actor ordering, camera or coordinate-width profiles.

fixture.provenance: Independently authored text payload, generated with 7z-wasm ZipCrypto. The pinned incorrect password passes the short encryption header check and fails CRC verification with the original reader. No personal data or external credentials.
